items.title: The image of a universally closed stack under a surjective morphism is universally closed, and proper when it is separated of finite type
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a surjective image of an algebraic stack which is universally closed over a base is again universally closed over that base, and proper when it is also separated and of finite type (author lemma at source lines 8694-8705, label lemma-image-proper-is-proper). The proof (source lines 8707-8720) takes an arbitrary base change, uses the stability of surjectivity under base change to compute the image of a closed subset through the two structure morphisms, and concludes that the relevant map on topological spaces is closed (proof lines 8708-8719). The transport of closed subsets through the surjection is the content. H2.
